name: 86 Chaos 16.0.12 Schedule Builder Events Visibility Fix
label: 16.0.12 Schedule Builder Events Visibility Fix
notes: Shows scheduled special events directly inside Schedule Builder by date so managers can staff heavier days without opening Event Calendar separately.
Adds a compact event/coverage row above staff rows with event time, title, and notes in the hover title.
Keeps the desktop schedule grid dense and preserves the recent mobile modal keyboard focus fix.
